tool_call.why: To identify all currently operating and under-construction ethylene plants in Southeast Asia, including their capacities, companies, and plant details. This addresses the questions about current capacity, main contributors, and recent changes or expansions.

reason: The plant register is the primary source for supply base details. This call will provide a list of plants, their capacities, and operators, as well as highlight any recent additions or expansions if new plants are under construction.
